name: 归档桶跟随分组
desc: 左栏选中分组后「已归档」「垃圾桶」两个视图只显示该分组的条目（选「全部任务」才是全部）：视图标签数量、底栏统计、空状态文案同步跟随；「清空垃圾桶」只清当前分组范围，不动其它分组；删除倒计时的 5 秒等待用宿主数值 wait 步骤

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.dlgHead = () => T.tx(T.dlg().querySelector('[slot=headline]')); T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.titles = () => T.items().map((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text'))); T.need = (t) => { const i = T.items().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.text')) === t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.item = (t) => T.items().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.text')) === t) || null; T.labels = () => T.q('st-button-group st-button').map((b) => T.tx(b)); T.view = (t) => T.click(T.q('st-button-group st-button').find((b) => T.tx(b).indexOf(t) === 0)); T.addGroup = async (name) => { T.btn('新建分组'); await T.wait(400); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('新建分组弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-input'), name); await T.wait(300); T.dlgBtn('创建'); await T.wait(450); return true; }; T.pickGroup = (name) => { const g = T.q('.gitem').find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.gname')) === name); if (!g) throw new Error('找不到分组：' + name); g.querySelector('.gname').click(); return true; }; T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(400); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(300); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(450); return true; }; T.toggle = (t) => T.click(T.need(t).querySelector('st-checkbox').shadowRoot.querySelector('input')); T.del = (t) => T.click(Array.from(T.need(t).querySelectorAll('.item-actions st-icon-button'))[1]); return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); await T.addGroup('工作'); T.pickGroup('工作'); await T.wait(350); await T.addTask('工作项', ''); T.toggle('工作项'); await T.wait(450); T.btn('归档已完成'); await T.wait(500); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('归档后当前分组列表应为空，实际 ' + T.titles()); if (T.labels().indexOf('已归档 1') === -1) throw new Error('已归档标签应带数量：' + T.labels()); T.pickGroup('全部任务'); await T.wait(350); await T.addTask('默认项', ''); T.del('默认项'); await T.wait(500); if (T.need('默认项').className.indexOf('pending') === -1) throw new Error('「默认项」应进入倒计时'); return 'deleted';

await T.ready('.shell'); T.pickGroup('工作'); await T.wait(400); T.view('垃圾桶'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('「工作」下的垃圾桶不应出现其它分组的条目，实际 ' + T.titles()); const empty = T.q('.empty')[0]; if (!empty || T.tx(empty).indexOf('「工作」的垃圾桶是空的') === -1) throw new Error('垃圾桶空状态应带分组名：' + (empty && T.tx(empty))); const f = T.tx(T.q('.footer .count')[0]); if (f !== '垃圾桶 0 项') throw new Error('底栏应只数当前分组：' + f); if (T.labels().indexOf('垃圾桶 1') !== -1) throw new Error('标签数量不应再显示其它分组的条目：' + T.labels()); if (!T.byText('st-button', '清空垃圾桶').hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('当前分组垃圾桶为空时「清空垃圾桶」应置灰'); return 'ok';

T.view('已归档'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('「工作」下的已归档应有 1 条，实际 ' + T.items().length); if (!T.item('工作项')) throw new Error('「工作」下应看到本分组的归档项：' + T.titles()); const f = T.tx(T.q('.footer .count')[0]); if (f !== '已归档 1 项') throw new Error('归档底栏计数不正确：' + f); T.pickGroup('默认'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('「默认」下不应看到「工作」的归档项，实际 ' + T.titles()); const empty = T.q('.empty')[0]; if (!empty || T.tx(empty).indexOf('「默认」的归档箱是空的') === -1) throw new Error('归档空状态应带分组名：' + (empty && T.tx(empty))); T.view('垃圾桶'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 1 || !T.item('默认项')) throw new Error('「默认」下的垃圾桶应有 1 条：' + T.titles()); return 'ok';

T.pickGroup('全部任务'); await T.wait(400); T.view('已归档'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 1 || !T.item('工作项')) throw new Error('「全部任务」下已归档应有 1 条：' + T.titles()); T.view('垃圾桶'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 1 || !T.item('默认项')) throw new Error('「全部任务」下垃圾桶应有 1 条：' + T.titles()); if (T.labels().indexOf('已归档 1') === -1 || T.labels().indexOf('垃圾桶 1') === -1) throw new Error('「全部任务」下标签数量应为全量：' + T.labels()); const f = T.tx(T.q('.footer .count')[0]); if (f !== '垃圾桶 1 项') throw new Error('全量底栏计数不正确：' + f); return 'ok';

T.pickGroup('工作'); await T.wait(400); T.view('垃圾桶'); await T.wait(450); T.click(T.byText('st-button', '清空垃圾桶')); await T.wait(450); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('当前分组垃圾桶为空时不应弹出确认框'); T.pickGroup('默认'); await T.wait(450); T.click(T.byText('st-button', '清空垃圾桶')); await T.wait(450); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('「清空垃圾桶」应弹二次确认'); if (T.dlgHead() !== '清空「默认」的垃圾桶？') throw new Error('确认框标题应带分组：' + T.dlgHead()); if (d.textContent.indexOf('「默认」垃圾桶里的 1 项') === -1) throw new Error('确认框应说明范围与条数：' + d.textContent); T.dlgBtn('确认'); await T.wait(650); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('清空后当前分组垃圾桶应为空，实际 ' + T.titles()); T.pickGroup('全部任务'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('清空范围应只限「默认」分组，实际 ' + T.titles()); if (T.labels().indexOf('垃圾桶 1') !== -1) throw new Error('垃圾桶徒标应消失：' + T.labels()); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
